en: Sepia-toned illustrated postcard showing a two-story town building with dormer windows and decorative gables, likely from the early 20th century. Signs on the façade identify it as a confectionery or pastry shop named 'Conditorei Hermann Göhlitzer,' with another smaller sign reading 'Conditorei Café'. Trees line the street in the foreground, and the artist's signature 'Erich Eiland' appears in the lower right corner. The overall style resembles a pen-and-ink architectural drawing reproduced as a postcard.
